title: Suspect dies after police use stun gun
article: A 39-year-old man is dead after police used a stun gun during his arrest.
Niagara Regional Police went to a neighbourhood in Beamsville, Ont., west of St. Catharines, following reports of numerous break-ins in the area.
While on the scene, they tried to arrest a suspect identified as James Foldi.
Police say a Taser gun was used during his arrest early Friday.
Mr. Foldi was taken into police custody but was sent to hospital after officers said he appeared to be in "medical distress."
A post-mortem is scheduled for this afternoon in Hamilton.
The case is now being investigated by the Special Investigations Unit, as is usual for police and civilian incidents when is someone killed.
